landing.badge: North Eastern Region Early Warning System (NER-LEWS)
landing.welcome_title: Welcome to the NER Landslide Monitoring Platform
landing.welcome_subtitle: AI-Powered Early Warning, Geotechnical Telemetry & Dissemination for North East India
landing.user_portal_desc: Report active landslides, rockfalls, and road fissures. Sign in to track mitigation status and SDRF response notes, or submit an instant report as a guest.
landing.officer_dashboard_desc: Dedicated operations console for District Disaster Management Authorities (DDMA), PWD engineers, and State Disaster Response Force (SDRF).
landing.hero_title: Early Warning & Real-Time Landslide Risk Monitoring for North East India
landing.hero_subtitle: Integrating antecedent rainfall thresholds, geotechnical slope kinematics, and crowdsourced citizen surveillance along the strategic Lumding-Badarpur and NH-27 hill corridors.
landing.challenge_desc: The young Tertiary formations of North East India face severe seasonal crises. Multiple complex triggers converge to create catastrophic slope failures:
landing.challenge_rain_desc: Monsoon rainfall frequently exceeds 250mm in 72 hours, creating acute pore-water pressure along shale-sandstone boundaries.
landing.challenge_geo_desc: Disang & Barail sedimentary formations are heavily jointed, weathered, and prone to rapid translational debris flows.
landing.challenge_lifeline_desc: Blockages on NH-27 and the Lumding-Badarpur rail link repeatedly isolate southern Assam, Tripura, and Mizoram.
landing.citizen_door_desc: Zero-friction hazard reporting for landslides, mudflows, cracks, and blocked highway passes.
landing.officer_door_desc: Jurisdiction-scoped surveillance, geotechnical risk telemetry, and rapid SDRF/NDRF dispatch.
